IV. 3. 34</ls>]. अथाजिनाषाढधरः प्रमाथी. .{@-ढः@} .²1 The month Āṣāḍha commencing with the Sunʼs entrance into Gemini (usually written आषाढ). .²2 A staff made of the wood of Palāśa, carried by a religious student or ascetic. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the Malaya mountain. .{@-ढा@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a constellation, the twentieth (पूर्वाषाढा) and twenty-first (उत्तराषाढा) lunar mansions; <ls>Av. 19. 7. 4</ls>.
